title: KLS Isoperimetric Coefficient Bound for Log-Concave Measures
exact_target: Let $\mu$ be a log-concave probability measure on $\mathbb R^d$. Write $h(\mu)$ for the Cheeger infimum of boundary measure divided by the smaller mass of a set and its complement, and $h_{\mathrm{half}}(\mu)$ for that infimum restricted to half-spaces. Is there a universal $c>0$ for which $h(\mu)\geq c\,h_{\mathrm{half}}(\mu)$ for all $d$ and $\mu$?
